name: jev-native
description: Jev decision support for public or synthetic review and security-research queues.

interface.shortDescription: Ranking, classification, and claim review with Jev.
interface.longDescription: Sends reviewed public or synthetic decision payloads through a loopback or private-network MCP to the hosted TypeSafe Jev API. Adds advisory ranking, fixed-taxonomy classification, claim review, and an optional security-triage workflow. It never authorizes, discards, submits, or executes anything.
defaultPrompt: Audit this public source queue without dropping anything.
Compare this public claim with its exact evidence span.
Extract atomic signals from this larger synthetic queue.
